scenarios.name: ICAEnumeration-01 valid slot with ICA passes validation

steps.text: an ICA slot RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED with is_na false and one ICA referencing hazard H-1 and constraint SC-1
the ICA enumeration is validated against the loss analysis and control structure
validation succeeds

scenarios.name: ICAEnumeration-02 valid N/A slot passes validation

steps.text: an ICA slot RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED with is_na true and na_justification no hazardous context
the ICA enumeration is validated against the loss analysis and control structure
validation succeeds

scenarios.name: ICAEnumeration-03 N/A slot without na_justification fails

steps.text: an ICA slot RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED with is_na true and no na_justification
the ICA enumeration is validated against the loss analysis and control structure
validation fails with error containing na_justification

scenarios.name: ICAEnumeration-04 N/A slot with ICAs fails

steps.text: an ICA slot RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED with is_na true, na_justification none, and one ICA
the ICA enumeration is validated against the loss analysis and control structure
validation fails with error containing icas

scenarios.name: ICAEnumeration-05 non-N/A slot with empty ICAs fails

steps.text: an ICA slot RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED with is_na false and zero ICAs
the ICA enumeration is validated against the loss analysis and control structure
validation fails with error containing icas

scenarios.name: ICAEnumeration-06 non-N/A slot with na_justification fails

steps.text: an ICA slot RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED with is_na false, one ICA, and na_justification set
the ICA enumeration is validated against the loss analysis and control structure
validation fails with error containing na_justification

scenarios.name: ICAEnumeration-07 ICA referencing non-existent hazard fails

steps.text: an ICA slot RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED with is_na false and one ICA referencing hazard H-99
the ICA enumeration is validated against the loss analysis and control structure
validation fails with error containing related_hazards

scenarios.name: ICAEnumeration-08 ICA referencing non-existent constraint fails

steps.text: an ICA slot RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED with is_na false and one ICA referencing constraint SC-99
the ICA enumeration is validated against the loss analysis and control structure
validation fails with error containing related_constraints
two ICA slots with the same slot_id RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED

scenarios.name: ICAEnumeration-10 all UCA types are accepted

steps.text: an ICA slot RESP-1:CA-1-1:<uca_type> with is_na false and one ICA
